## Question

What single tuning question does this experiment answer?

## Setup

## Filament

Manufacturer, product, material, color, lot, drying, and storage:

## Software

Slicer/version and printer, filament, and process profile revisions:

## Controlled Variables

What stayed fixed? What one variable changed?

## Evidence

Attach or link the project, G-code, checksum, photographs, raw measurements,
and calculation.

## Result

State the observation, interpretation, decision, uncertainty, and proposed
guide change separately.
